messages:
elaine: Quick sync — polishing the Private setup wizard (connectivity flow). Need copy + a11y check on the 'Network prerequisites' step before we ship tomorrow. Screenshots in the thread. mike: on it. Do we want 'Test connection' or 'Validate network'? I'm leaning 'Validate network' since it runs multiple checks. jenny: +1 for 'Validate network'. also suggest microcopy under the button: 'Runs firewall, route, and DNS checks (takes ~15s)'. keeps expectations. sohail: engineering: the current validation runs port + CIDR + DNS. If we say 'firewall' that's fine but don't promise UDP checks (we don't do that). Maybe 'port & DNS checks'. elaine: good catch. proposed copy: Button: "Validate network" Helper text: "Checks ports, routes, and DNS resolution (≈15s)." jenny: looks good. one a11y nit: the helper text isn't keyboard-accessible when focus is on the button. We should ensure it's tied to aria-describedby on the button. sohail: we can add aria-describedby to the button id. example:
Checks ports, routes, and DNS resolution (≈15s)
devon: QA: when validation fails we show a modal with logs. Current modal is >600px and not scrollable with keyboard. Need to ensure focus trap + scrollable content. elaine: agree — modal content should be focusable and use role="dialog" with aria-modal="true". Also let's add clear next steps in the error state: 'Which ports to open' + sample iptables rules. mike: add a collapsed 'how to fix' panel in the modal to keep it small by default. jenny: small copy tweak for success state: currently says 'You're good!'. Suggest 'Network validated — ready to deploy.' more explicit. sohail: fine by backend. Also note: validation returns an array of failedChecks; we should surface the most actionable one first (e.g., 'port 8080 blocked') elaine: yes reorder UX to put actionable failure first, then raw logs collapsed. devon: accessibility: color contrast on the status pill (green) is borderline in dark mode. Can we use a darker green or add icon + text? :warning: jenny: add icon + text and don't rely on color alone. 'Success' with check icon. elaine: UX question — do we keep inline 'guide me' link next to each failed check that opens contextual docs? good for customers. mike: yes, add 'guide me' per failure line that opens right pane with exact mitigation steps. sohail: adding links is fine. just ensure the links are external and open in new tab with rel=noopener. ops-bot: screenshot uploaded: /files/IMG-validate-modal.png :camera_flash: elaine: thanks. last thing: keyboard flow — tab order should be: back, validate, continue (continue disabled until success), not skip helper links. jenny: I'll update the prototype and annotate tab indices. devon: I'll run accessibility scan on the updated build tomorrow morning and report regressions. mike: timeline — jenny updates by EOD, sohail implements aria change + modal fix, devon tests tomorrow. ship on Friday if clean. :thumbsup: elaine: perfect. if anyone spots extra copy edge cases (non-English locales) flag them here. jenny: note for localization: avoid '≈' and use 'about' — translators prefer words. elaine: changed: helper text becomes 'Checks ports, routes, and DNS resolution (about 15s)'. mike: ok locking that copy. thanks everyone.
